data.definition:
s9_settings_numbers_s11.py = s9_settings_numbers.py for S11 (option C) -> paper/numbers/bf_step9_settings_s11.json.
Step 9's settings as paper tokens (15 Nov), each read from the saved build where it is a measured value:
  feature_mm               anatomix feature resolution of arm D (step9.ARM_D_ENV R1X_FEATRES)
  max_interpolated_share   the selection rule of S12 (and so of S11): at most 10 % of sections interpolated (TESTS.md addendum 3; a rule constant)
  photographed_step_um     S11's L2 section steps (the L2 affine's section axis), min and max, per brain
  n_brains, n_inputs       S11 (S12 without MR263; addendum 16) and its inputs (each brain and its mirror)
  warp_mm, iterations      the step-9 jobs' warp grid (iteration jobs' reg_vox) and the completed iterations (it.done)
  pilot folds              out/pilot2_folds.json: block fields with any det J <= 0, per arm (C, D), and their fold voxels
    python step9/s9_settings_numbers_s11.py  -> paper/numbers/bf_step9_settings_s11.json

photographs.source_level: L2 (each brain's blockface_L2.nii.gz; hr.Native reads it)
photographs.paired_rule: adjacent sections averaged in pairs when the section step < 0.07 mm (hr.py PAIR_BELOW_MM)

data.definition_s11b:
bf_step9_settings_s11b (16 Nov, for the Methods' final-step paragraph): bf_step9_settings_s11's data unchanged (nothing
removed) plus the grids and the photographs' source, each read from the saved build:
  registration_grid_mm         the iteration jobs' reg_vox (out_s11/nln_step_09/iteration_0k/queue/jobs/*.json)
  intermediate_average_grid_mm the iteration templates T1s11-T3s11 (out_s11/combine_T{k}s11.json vox_mm, shape)
  mean_removal_grid_mm         the unbias (composition, damped fixed point) runs on step9_s11.py's VOX grid (= the iteration templates')
  final_average_grid_mm        T3s11 at 0.15 mm (out_015_s11/combine_T3s11.json vox_mm, shape)
  photographs                  the source level (each brain's data/sub-<S>/blockface/<S>_blockface_L2.nii.gz), in-plane pixel and
                               section step per brain (the L2 affine's column norms; the section axis is axis 1), and hr.py's pairing
                               rule (PAIR_BELOW_MM: sections closer than it are averaged in adjacent pairs) with the resulting step
  inverse_residual_mm_per_iteration  the mean-removal inverse's final residual (max, mm) and rounds (out_s11/unbias_it0k.json)
    PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 mri/env/mmorf/bin/python bftemplate/hr_2026-11-12/step9/s9_settings_numbers_s11b.py

polish.rule: the band about each member's record brain where its photograph's own mask is read (hr.polish_source; release blockface_step9.py POLISH_NEAR_VOX = settings step9.polish.near_vox)

s11w.note: the record's own script, unchanged, run on the final step made with the published weights; only its input folders changed
s11w.template_folder: the final step's template made with the published weights (bftemplate_step9)
s11w.control: a working file of the analysis (control_bf_step9_settings_s11b.json)
s11w.inputs_are_resolved: the link folder's files are recorded by their real paths
